meta.name: game-design-process
meta.description: The orchestrator for designing a game end to end. Use when starting or steering a game's design — "I'm making a game", "where do I start", "design this game with me", "what's next in the design", or running headless to take a concept to generated, reviewed content. Engine-agnostic; tuned for procedural / AI-authored games (e.g. a procgen open-world RPG in Godot). Sequences the pipeline and names which knowledge/process skill to pull at each phase. Stops at design/spec — does not write gameplay code.
